title: Incident note, halved
instruction: Rewrite the note below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten note, nothing else.
source: On Tuesday 3 March the gateway began rejecting uploads larger than 2 MiB with a 413, which ticket PLT-2291 traced to build 4.12.0-rc3 of the dispatch cell. Mendel Varga-Lindqvist found that the x-parc-writes header was being counted toward the body limit, contrary to RFC 7231 section 3.3. The fix, shipped in 4.12.1, excludes headers from the limit and raises it to 8 MiB. No data was lost, but 214 uploads from the Oakhaven tenant were retried by hand, and the on-call rota for Thursday was moved to cover the backlog.
